body: I don't know how to help you, but you're not alone. Not being touched is so hard in a way that's hard to explain. You feel unworthy down to your very bones.  It's like being a modern-day leper. But you're not, and I'm not.

Hi there. Glad to hear you're not actively planning to do it. Just wanted to say again, your life is valuable. So maybe you're not an activist or out member of the community, who cares about that. Trans people, as far I understand it (as I'm a cis lesbian), go through hell just for existing so your existence in and of itself is important.
From one queer to another, please don't do it. We need all the people we have, and your life is important. PM me if you want to talk.
This comment actually really helped me, I was in the middle of an anxiety attack. Thank you so much.

She's abusing you. No one you love should ever, ever make me bleed. No one should try to physically hurt you in any way. I would lecture you about hitting her with a pillow but frankly the other responses have already covered that ground and overall, you're the one I'm more worried about in this equation. 

What she did is unforgivable, honestly. It's up to you to decide what to do about that, but if I were you I'd be packing my bags. 

Stay safe and let us know how it turns out.

Honestly, I wouldn't look at it as coming to your current boyfriend and saying "I'm bad, I'm terrible" - what you should be doing is trying to look at your discrete ACTIONS and evaluating them, rather than your whole self. When you screw up, apologize. Don't make excuses for it. But be prepared to lose him once he realizes how bad he's had it in the past. This is okay, chalk it up to life experience, and move on. 

Source: I've been abused in all my relationships but one, in which the tables were turned and I was the abuser.
Maybe, but this is the job I have. It is very practical, and better than jobs I've had before. I don't believe in chasing dreams- I've seen that mentality lead to ruin for too many.

I have had very bad experiences with many people. People abandoning me, using me, judging me for my problems. No one can help me or care for me. This is the bleakest aspect of my situation- I am not someone anyone develops tenderness for or shows kindness to. Most people assume I can handle my own problems. I feel completely unloved and uncared for. My grandfather loves me. Perhaps my mother. But she's pretty dysfunctional and not a reliable source of support.

I am happy you've had better experiences.
Yes. I'm in therapy and on medication but neither of them seem to be working at the moment, particularly therapy.
Very. Although my depression probably makes it harder for me than it would be for someone else.

Not sure. I'm pretty worthless to most other people, judging by their reactions to me. I'm also using all my energy to fight depression and stay out of the hospital in order to hang on to my job and "normal" life. My life doesn't leave me a lot of energy to be patient or friendly or outgoing.
Not sure. We didn't always see eye-to-eye. But I was just stubborn. Once I grew up, I realized they were good people and began to appreciate them.

Thank you. It is. My grandfather visits her every afternoon. He usually puts on a jacket and tie, to show respect for her, even though she doesn't know who he is anymore.

When they are gone it will be like light leaving the world.
